lines: Kal chaudhvin ki raat thi, shab bhar raha charcha tera
couplets.en: Last night the moon was full, and we spoke of you till dawn.

lines: Kuchh ne kaha yeh chaand hai, kuchh ne kaha chehra tera
couplets.en: Some said it was the moon, others said it was your face.

lines: Hum bhi wahin maujood the, hum se bhi sab poochha kiye
couplets.en: I was there too, and everyone kept asking me.

lines: Hum hans diye, hum chup rahe, manzoor tha parda tera
couplets.en: I smiled and said nothing, content to keep you hidden.

lines: Is shahr mein kis se milen, hum se to chhooti mahfilen
couplets.en: Whom shall I see in this city, now that my gatherings are behind me?

lines: Har shakhs tera naam le, har shakhs deewana tera
couplets.en: Everyone speaks your name, and everyone is in love with you.

lines: Kooche ko tere chhod kar, jogi hi ban jaayen magar
couplets.en: I could leave your lane and become a wandering ascetic.

lines: Jangal tere, parbat tere, basti teri, sahra tera
couplets.en: Yet yours are the forests and mountains, the villages and the desert.
Last night the moon was full.
Hear me, dear heart, if you will.

lines: Bedard, sunni ho to chal, kehta hai kya achchhi ghazal
couplets.en: Come, heartless one, and hear what a lovely ghazal he recites.

lines: Aashiq tera, ruswa tera, shayar tera, Insha tera
couplets.en: Your lover, yours in disgrace, your poet, your Insha.

lines: Kal chaudhvin ki raat thi, shab bhar raha charcha tera
couplets.en: Last night the moon was full, and we spoke of you till dawn.
